name: shared-raw-templates-read
body:
Reading the deck's raw top-level `templates:` value from kalide.yaml — the value the library resolution needs before a theme registry exists, since deck.LoadConfig needs a theme registry that comes from the not-yet-resolved library — is defined once and used by the reload pipeline (internal/server/reload.go, server.configuredTemplates), the file watcher (internal/watch/watch.go, watch.configuredTemplates) and the CLI's library resolution (internal/cli/templates.go and internal/cli/start.go). A config that cannot be read, cannot be decoded, or has no `templates:` key yields the empty value that selects the deck-root `templates/` layer.

AC: the reload pipeline, the watcher and the CLI's library resolution read the raw `templates:` value through one shared implementation.
